# BAK-001: Platform database backups on the host

- **Group:** Backups
- **Severity when it fails:** info
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

The platform's own database holds every project, server, secret and key it manages; losing it means rebuilding all of it by hand. Coolify keeps local backups under /data/coolify/backups; Dokploy sends backups to S3 destinations only. A local copy alone is not a backup: keep one off the server, and keep the platform's app key somewhere else, since the database is useless without it.

## Verify by hand

```sh
ls -lR /data/coolify/backups | tail
```

## How to fix it

Schedule backups of the platform database to off site storage and test a restore; store the app key outside the server.
